name: KIC 11045572
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 9.0 solar radii and 1.49 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 11045572 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 8.9753 +/- 0.1556

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 11045572 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.4947 +/- 0.0576

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 11045572 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4671.069 +/- 42.5962

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 11045572 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.7083 +/- 0.0038

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the colour routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.49 solar masses and 9.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,671 K at its surface.
